title: Nordstrom Is Offering Up to 60% Off During its Half-Year Sale on Celeb-Loved Brands Like Ugg, La Mer & On Running
summary: This sale includes products like footwear, skincare and luggage.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

It’s that time of year again to shop up to 60% off during Nordstrom’s beloved Half-Year sale.

This time around, the brand’s biannual sale features a slew of celeb-loved products from top brands including UGG , AllSaints, Marc Jacobs , On Running, La Mer, Adidas and more. While Christmas might be over, you can still shop to treat yourself to something new. Maybe you have a New Year’s party that you’re not sure what to wear to.

Maybe you have ambitious New Year’s resolutions? Or are you more of the chill type, looking to lounge as the ball drops? Whatever scenario you might be shopping for, either for yourself or others, Nordstrom’s Half-Year sale has got everything you might need to kick off 2026 right. Below, we’ve compiled a few of our favorite items from the sale, including sneakers, PJs, LED face masks, skincare and even luggage, all marked down up to 60% off.

Fashion

PJ Salvage Holiday Softee Pajamas

$49 $98 50% off

Buy Now at nordstrom

A PJ set in gray with bow accents.

From Jennifer Lopez to Hailey Bieber, every celeb has been sporting bows. The trending piece coincides with the balletcore trend that began to pick up steam in 2024 and has since practically taken over, seen on everything from notebooks to planners and now, pajamas. If you want to stay on trend and save yourself a few bucks, this PJ Salvage set , now currently 50% off , is for you.

The style is super soft and stretchy, awesome for catching zzz’s, and is equipped with pink bow detailing that harkens back to the balletcore trend. With the long sleeves and matching long bottoms, these PJs are nice and warm, even on the coldest nights. You’ll want to shop quickly since there are only a few sizes left.

The Noli Shop Kaia Pearl High Rise Jean

$128 $198 35% off

Buy Now at nordstrom

High-rise denim with pearl detailing.

Getting ready for a New Year’s party? Why not take a page out of Taylor Swift , Demi Lovato or Dolly Parton ’s style book? Each musician has sported sparkling denim, much like this The Noli style , at one point or another — whether on stage or off. Denim like this style upgrades an otherwise basic silhouette, taking denim from an everyday staple to party-ready with help from a few sparkles and pearls. Right now, the Kaia silhouette is 35% off at Nordstrom and comes in sizes 24 to 33.

All in Favor Strapless Sequin Minidress

$35.75 $65 45% off

Buy Now at nordstrom

A strapless red sequin dress with bow detailing.

Speaking of sparkles, this All in Favor Strapless Sequin Minidress is another sure-fire way to turn heads at a New Year’s event. It also doubles as a superb formal number for work events or a special date night. This maximalist pick retails for $35.75 , 45% off the OG price, and comes in a strapless mini style made of a high-shine red sequin fabric. The back of the dress is equipped with a bow, a detail we’ve mentioned being super popular with the likes of Jennifer Lopez and Hailey Bieber, among others.

AllSaints Distortion OTH Hooded Pullover

$143.40 $239 40% off

Buy Now at nordstrom

A gray longsleeve in a slouchy style.

From Charli xcx to Jisoo to Kelly Clarkson , a bunch of musicians have been seen in digs from AllSaints . Right now, men can channel the swagger of the artists mentioned above by shopping this AllSaints hoodie, a cozy pick, on sale for $143.40 . The designer style is dark gray and comes in an oversized style that makes layering under jean jackets or over tees a stylish and easy choice. AllSaints graphics can be seen throughout the piece in squiggly font, a street style-inspired graphic that immediately draws the eye.

Nordstrom Plaid Flannel Pajamas

$51.35 $79 35% off

Buy Now at nordstrom

A flannel pajama set.

Waiting to watch the ball drop at home? If you’re ringing in 2026 cozied up, these plaid PJs from Nordstrom might be the best attire to do so. The men’s style is currently 35% off and comes in red and blue plaid in sizes medium to XL. If the red and blue colorway isn’t your thing, Nordstrom also has an alternate green style with even more sizes. Flannel PJs are extremely festive and very thick, keeping the cold at bay while you celebrate the new year on the couch.

Hollywood Sensations Dome Huggie Teardrop Earrings

$48 $65 26% off

Buy Now at norDua Lipadstrom

Chunky silver hoop earrings.

Dua Lipa , Rihanna and Hailey Bieber have all been known to sport stylish chunky silver hoops , much like these from Hollywood Sensations. This style is currently 26% off and features a modern sculptural teardrop shape. If silver isn’t your thing, there’s also a gold option in the same style. These chunky hoops would make an excellent addition to any New Year’s look, or a late Christmas gift for a friend if you still haven’t bought one.

Marc Jacobs The Snapshot Pochette Bag

$117 $195 40% off

Buy Now at nordstrom

A colorful Marc Jacobs shoulder bag.

Marc Jacobs’ Snapshot Pochette Bag is a beloved one. It’s a dual style that can be worn over the shoulder or crossbody, depending on your mood. This colorful pick is currently 40% off at Nordstrom, which is just $117 , an affordable price to pay for a designer bag. Square, colorful and full of personality, the Pochette bag is a surefire conversation starter, especially for New Year’s or any special event you might have. If you’re more of the maximalist type, this bag could be an everyday item, too.

Beauty

Fresh Firm Foundations Set $73 Value

$29 $51 43% off

Buy Now at nordstrom

A set of skincare from Fresh.

K-pop star Joy from Red Velvet is a Fresh global brand ambassador and, as such, she’s been known to use the brand’s products from time to time. The brand’s skincare products are innovative and science-backed, giving users a spa-like experience in their own homes. Right now, you can get two of Fresh’s best-selling products, the Soy Face Cleanser and Black Tea Advanced Age Renewal Cream , all for $29. That’s a $73 value, with products that work for all skin types to cleanse, hydrate and firm.

PURSONIC LED Light Therapy Face Mask

$69.99 $169.99 59% off

Buy Now at nordstrom

An LED face mask.

Looking for a spa treatment at home? The Kardashians, namely Kourtney and Kim, have used red light therapy in the past, treating themselves and their skin to a rejuvenating experience without all the spa pricing. Red light masks, like this one from PURSONIC , use low-level red and near-infrared light to penetrate skin and stimulate mitochondria, boosting cellular energy, or ATP. The result? Faster healing, collagen production and reduced blemishes and inflammation. This LED mask is currently 59% off at Nordstrom, a steal when considering most masks of the same caliber can run you up to $200.

La Mer The Holiday Essentials Skincare Gift Set

$464 $580 20% off

Buy Now at nordstrom

A La Mer gift set with three products.

La Mer is just one of those luxe brands that no one can afford unless you’re a celeb. Speaking of, stars like Jennifer Lopez, Kim Kardashian, Selena Gomez , Beyoncé and Ariana Grande have all used the brand in the past, specifically its best-seller Creme de La Mer . If you want to get luxury skincare your fave musicians use, without maxing out your credit card, this three-piece La Mer set might be for you. You’ll be getting three products for $464 — roughly $154.66 per product. The three-piece holiday essentials box includes La Mer’s The Essence Foaming Cleanser, The Eye Concentrate and the ever-popular Creme de La Mer.

Footwear

Buy Now at nordstrom
